Design contracts. Bound stubs are not implemented business behavior. JSON Schema cannot express all cross-field or stored-state obligations.

API reference · Service JSON · Exact contract sources · Source hashes

Surface → API / MCP → service → event

Page API references declare intended usage; actual page calls are not enforced here. Widget sources declare intended connections, not payload compatibility; planned projection gaps are explicit and no product artifacts are published. Event relationships declare possible emission; transaction, replay and external-producer behavior remain implementation obligations. Event-specific gaps are listed explicitly.

Feature filters include both the surface owner and referenced service requirements. Cross-feature dependencies stay visible. Bound means a declared mapping, not implemented business behavior. Widgets display results; prompts name required capabilities, not execution sequences.

Recorded implementation obligations (12)
  • Bind list/detail variants and include bounded objectives for a cycle detail; never render a deleted cycle.
  • Compact MCP records omit cycle, results and actions required by the page-mirroring payload.
  • Supply bounded parent figures, trend and evidence alongside the compact MCP result.
  • Compose the cycle, objective grouping and remaining open actions server-side; a mutation receipt alone is insufficient.
  • Supply parent labels and bounded action history alongside the compact MCP action.
  • Project list responses and obtain the bounded refreshed list after a mutation; never repeat writes for pagination.
  • Bind the note field from structuredContent to the declared payload; stored text stays untrusted.
  • Supply the detail/list variant and bounded session actions; compact session results do not satisfy detail payloads.
  • Provide the complete session record and selected canonical document text; render stored text as data, never instructions.
  • Project the active briefing into the dashboard payload; no coaching card for unpaid access.
  • Specify treatment of calls without authenticated identity; tenant event storage requires an actor.
  • Specify trusted server recording and repeat-visit deduplication; the page alone is not an authorized event writer.

Service definitions

cycles.create · write · contract-only

Feature declaration: createCycle

Requirement: docs/feature-specs/F2-cycles.md · Access: entitled-write

Tables: cycles (write), objectives (read), idempotency_keys (write)

Trusted context: authenticated actor

Retry: Actor/operation/key-scoped original-outcome replay, including post-commit response failures.

Expected errors: UNAUTHORIZED, BAD_REQUEST, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

objectives.update · write · contract-only

Feature declaration: updateObjective

Requirement: docs/feature-specs/F3-objectives.md · Access: entitled-write

Tables: objectives (write), cycles (read), results (read), actions (read)

Expected errors: UNAUTHORIZED, BAD_REQUEST, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

results.preview_deletion · write · contract-only

Feature declaration: previewResultDeletion

Requirement: docs/feature-specs/F4-results.md · Access: entitled-write

Tables: results (read), result_logs (read), habit_logs (read)

Trusted context: authenticated actor

Retry: Preview does not authorize deletion. Commit rechecks actor, target, impact, expiry and application approval; incomplete impact fails closed.

Expected errors: UNAUTHORIZED, BAD_REQUEST, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

results.create · write · contract-only

Feature declaration: createResult

Requirement: docs/feature-specs/F4-results.md · Access: entitled-write

Tables: results (write), cycles (read), objectives (read), result_logs (read), habit_logs (read), idempotency_keys (write)

Trusted context: authenticated actor

Retry: API requires client-key replay; unkeyed MCP calls must inspect state after an uncertain outcome.

Expected errors: UNAUTHORIZED, BAD_REQUEST, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

results.update · write · contract-only

Feature declaration: updateResult

Requirement: docs/feature-specs/F4-results.md · Access: entitled-write

Tables: results (write), cycles (read), objectives (read), result_logs (read), habit_logs (read)

Trusted context: authenticated actor

Retry: Inspect state after uncertain outcomes; never infer rollback from a response failure.

Expected errors: UNAUTHORIZED, BAD_REQUEST, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

habit_logs.set · write · contract-only

Feature declaration: setHabitLog

Requirement: docs/feature-specs/F4-results.md · Access: entitled-write

Tables: habit_logs (write), results (read), cycles (read), objectives (read), result_logs (read)

Trusted context: authenticated actor

Retry: Repeated desired day state is safe; a comment is evidence and must not be blindly repeated.

Expected errors: UNAUTHORIZED, BAD_REQUEST, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

actions.update · write · contract-only

Tables: actions (write), cycles (read), objectives (read), sessions (read), action_logs (read)

Feature declaration: reorderAction

Requirement: docs/feature-specs/F5-actions.md · Access: entitled-write

Tables: actions (write), cycles (read), objectives (read), sessions (read), action_logs (read)

Trusted context: authenticated actor

Retry: Inspect state after uncertain outcomes; never infer rollback from a response failure.

Expected errors: UNAUTHORIZED, BAD_REQUEST, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

Tables: action_logs (write), actions (write), cycles (read), objectives (read), sessions (read), idempotency_keys (write)

Expected errors: UNAUTHORIZED, BAD_REQUEST, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

Feature declaration: previewNoteDeletion

Requirement: docs/feature-specs/F6-notes.md · Access: entitled-write

Tables: notes (read)

Trusted context: authenticated actor

Retry: Preview does not authorize deletion. Commit rechecks actor, target, impact, expiry and application approval; incomplete impact fails closed.

Expected errors: UNAUTHORIZED, BAD_REQUEST, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
